label: Rehearsal sheet: Moving and Attacking show the posed frames (round 2: views snap on their keys, A021 items in hand); tap a move's ▶ to play it
Turning slash, slow (round 2: each key's drawings from the frame it is reached)
Backhand, slow: across in front (chest toward camera) -> side-on -> behind (turned away)
Spin finisher, slow: three-quarter -> side -> back (smear arm) -> front -> three-quarter (no more slide between views)
Overhead chop with the hand axe, slow: lean back with the raised arm -> hunched, overhead smear down in front
Staff overhead, slow: the staff raised behind his head in the far raised fist, both hands overhand -> chopped down hunched
Staff swing, slow: wound turned away -> swept through toward the camera
Spear thrust, slow: side-on chest and hips, out-turned rear boot on the lunge
Dagger stab, slow: reverse grip on the dagger, side-on
Dagger throw, slow: the dagger leaves the open hand and flies, turning over
Dash attack, slow: hunched, off the trailing toe
Jump attack, slow: rise cocked -> top turned away -> chop down in front -> land
Block with the round shield on the guard arm's strap, slow
Shield bash, slow: side-on, the shield driven forward off the trailing toe
Bow draw / aim / release, slow (open hand on the loose)
Dodge roll, slow: tuck -> back to the camera mid-roll -> up on the knee
Run (in place): hunched chest, both feet up between steps
Skid stop, slow: leaning back on the out-turned trailing boot
